description: Run DeepThonk through the shared core engine.

api_key_env.description: Environment variable that contains the API key.

config_path.description: Optional DeepThonk YAML config path, such as ~/.config/deepthonk/config.yaml.

finalizer_model.description: Optional model used to polish the winning candidate.

generator_model.description: Model used for initial candidate generation.

include_prompts.description: Store rendered prompts in candidate/comparison metadata.

include_raw_model_outputs.description: Store raw provider responses in trace metadata.

k.description: Comparisons per candidate per mutation-generation round.

m.description: Comparisons per candidate in the final dense ranking round. Mutation count per generation is n - ceil(n/4), not m.

max_calls.description: Maximum logical model invocations, including failed calls and invalid-JSON retries; internal HTTP retries are reported separately.

max_input_tokens.description: Maximum recorded input tokens before the run stops at a phase boundary.

max_output_tokens.description: Maximum recorded output tokens before the run stops at a phase boundary.

max_usd.description: Maximum estimated USD spend; requires matching budget.prices in config.

n.description: Population size override. Defaults to the profile's n.

profile.description: Run profile. quick is safest for smoke tests; paper plans 285 calls.

profile_name.description: Saved profile bundle name; loads ~/.config/deepthonk/profiles/<name>.yaml. Mutually exclusive with config_path.

prompt_style.description: Prompt template style. Defaults to paper-programming for the paper profile, general otherwise.

prompts.description: Optional per-phase prompt template overrides. Templates use {task}, {rubric}, {candidate}, {candidateA}, {candidateB}, {critique} placeholders. Use {{ and }} to escape literal braces. See docs/customization.md for the variable contract per phase.

compare.description: Variables: {task}, {rubric}, {candidateA}, {candidateB}. Output must be strict JSON: {feedback_a, feedback_b, winner: A|B|tie}.

provider.description: Provider label. Built-ins include fake, deepseek, openrouter, and openai-compatible; custom labels require base_url.

provider_max_concurrency.description: Process-shared maximum concurrent calls to this provider route.

rank.description: Final ranking mode, degree, seed, and logical-call limit.

request_timeout_ms.description: Logical provider-call deadline in milliseconds, including body reads and retry waits.

sampling_cost_priority.description: MCP Sampling model preference for lower cost, from 0 to 1.

sampling_intelligence_priority.description: MCP Sampling model preference for intelligence, from 0 to 1.

sampling_model_hints.description: Optional MCP Sampling model hints. Hints guide host model choice but do not enforce it.

sampling_speed_priority.description: MCP Sampling model preference for speed, from 0 to 1.

seed.description: Deterministic seed for pair ordering and IDs.

supports_json_mode.description: Whether the base OpenAI-compatible provider supports response_format JSON mode.

t.description: Number of mutation generations (t=0 disables mutation rounds).

task.description: Task text to solve. MCP tools do not read task files.

name: deepthonk.run
title: Run DeepThonk
